# Expand step of the expand/backfill/cutover/contract sequence for
# adding customer display_name while old and new application processes
# overlap during a rolling deployment.
#
# Rollout plan, one step per deploy:
#   1. Expand (this migration): add the nullable display_name column.
#      Old code ignores it; new code writes both name and display_name.
#   2. Backfill: a later, bounded, rerunnable migration populates
#      display_name from name in batches; it can be interrupted and
#      resumed, and its completion criterion is "no NULL rows remain".
#   3. Cutover: switch reads to display_name while writes continue to
#      maintain both columns.
#   4. Contract: only after no running version reads name, a separate
#      migration removes the old column.
#
# The destructive removal is deliberately NOT part of this migration:
# removing name here would break every old process still reading it.
class ExpandCustomerName < ActiveRecord::Migration[8.1]
  def change
    add_column :customers, :display_name, :string
  end
end
